scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:foundation-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-ci --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "node tests/emulator-verification.mjs"
scripts.test:phase2-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-phase2 --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore "node tests/phase2-emulator-integration.mjs"
scripts.test:phase3-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-phase3 --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore "node tests/phase3-emulator-integration.mjs"
scripts.test:phase5-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-phase5 --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore "node tests/phase5-emulator-integration.mjs"
scripts.test:phase7-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-phase7 --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore "node tests/phase7-emulator-integration.mjs"
scripts.test:firebase: npm run test:foundation-emulator && npm run test:rules && npm run test:phase2-emulator && npm run test:provisioning-emulator && npm run test:rules:phase3 && npm run test:storage:rules && npm run test:phase3-emulator && npm run test:rules:phase5 && npm run test:phase5-emulator && npm run test:phase7-emulator
scripts.verify:static: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run functions:build && npm run build && npm run test:release
scripts.verify: npm run verify:static && npm run test:firebase
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.json
scripts.emulators:export: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.json --import .firebase/emulator-data --export-on-exit .firebase/emulator-data
scripts.ios:build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode ios && node scripts/ios-bundle-check.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.test:provisioning-emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-first-pit-provisioning --config firebase.json --only auth,functions,firestore "node tests/provisioning-emulator-integration.mjs"
